body.x: Samsung Electronics (www.samsung.com), one of the leaders in the global market in high-tech electronics manufacturing and digital media, unveiled Galaxy Note Edge at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.With a curved screen that wraps around the side of the display, users can access to apps, weather, music, and clock without having to change the main screen. The Edge screen keeps the notifications and alerts neatly organized on the curved side, without interrupting videos, web browsing or taking attention away from getting work done.The 5.6-inch Quad HD Super AMOLED display provides clearer and brighter image. Also, the improved response time provides faster moving pictures from movies and games.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
